title: The Coquina House
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “The Coquina House”, a luxury 5-bed, 4.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 26 guests, this gated half-acre retreat offers a Private Pool, EV Charger & Golf Cart for your enjoyment. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Private Pool (Pool can be heated for an additional $100 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) -EV charging station -6 Seater Golf Cart Included -6 Adult Bikes -Event/Retreat Friendly -Lake Views Discover a truly exceptional coastal retreat where nature, design, and well-being come together in perfect harmony. Set behind private gates on a rare half-acre estate along iconic 30A, this 4,283-square-foot residence offers a sense of privacy and serenity seldom found so close to the beach and all that 30A has to offer. Surrounded by nature and enhanced by peaceful water views, the home is a vision of modern, mindful living, meticulously crafted with exceptional craftsmanship and wellness at its core. The light-filled main level welcomes you into an entertainer’s dream. A chef’s kitchen anchors the space, featuring a premium Lacanche gas range, custom white oak cabinetry, and a discreet scullery designed for effortless hosting. The open-concept living and dining areas flow seamlessly, creating an inviting setting ideal for gatherings, celebrations, and events of all sizes. A private guest suite with an en suite bath completes the first floor, offering comfort and convenience for visiting guests. The second level hosts two additional en suite bedrooms, along with a flexible twin/media room perfect for movie nights, creative use, or overflow accommodations. Thoughtful materials continue throughout the home, including natural, low-VOC finishes such as white oak flooring, beams, trim, walls, and ceilings, coquina shell stone flooring and surfaces, and clay-based paints, creating a healthy, grounding environment. Crowning the home on the third level is the serene primary suite, a private sanctuary with calming water views and a cozy artist’s nook. The spa-like bath invites relaxation with a soaking tub, walk-in shower, and dual custom closets designed for effortless organization. Outdoors, the property truly shines. The expansive grounds provide an exceptional backdrop for events, wellness retreats, and gatherings, featuring a large pool, cedar-clad pool house, and tranquil landscaping that enhances privacy and connection to nature. Dedicated wellness spaces, including a yoga studio and zen room, further elevate the home’s focus on renewal and mindful living. This gated half-acre estate is a rare offering along 30A, an entertainer’s dream that blends luxury, wellness, and natural beauty, perfectly suited for both intimate living and unforgettable events. Sleeping Arrangement -First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only 1/2 Bathroom -Second Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Queen Bedroom w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only Twin Bedroom w/ Trundle w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower Only -Third Floor Master Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate
